items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: So we said, "Well, take her, Benny, because you can do more for her than we can ever do for her," see.

ctx.x: She was a singer, a very pretty girl. One of the most beautiful girls you ever seen in your life. Beautiful complexion, pretty eyes, and had a nice little poise. Benny Goodman came through here and he heard her and he kind of liked her. So we said, "Well, take her, Benny, because you can do more for her than we can ever do for her," see. And so we turned her loose and Benny took her, but she didn't last long. I think she stayed with him two or three weeks.
